companyFieldUpdates.name: Metrus Energy
companyFieldUpdates.description: Metrus Energy, Inc. is a U.S. Energy-as-a-Service platform that finances, owns, operates and maintains energy-efficiency, HVAC, lighting, water, solar and storage upgrades under long-term Sustainable Energy Services Agreements. Customers include commercial and industrial businesses, higher-education institutions, healthcare systems, municipalities and nonprofits. ECP acquired the company in July 2022 and continues to classify it as current; public sources do not disclose the acquisition fund, vehicle, seller, stake, co-investors or exact legal closing day, and ECP Fund V is not directly supported for this investment. Metrus reported more than 940 sites across 34 U.S. states for 2025. Metrus-named project LLCs, financed equipment, installers, lenders, tax-equity providers and customers remain subordinate structures or counterparties rather than separate PortCos or platform owners. No corporate sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
